{{Top|leg}}
A '''subspace planetary relay''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]] communications [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] serving to receive, amplify, and retransmit commo transmissions toward some specified direction. While most relays were deployed in the void of deep space, some could be deployed on celestial bodies.
